title: Capture of Tabriz (1635)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Tabriz (1635)", at revision 1370609683, opens: "The Capture of Tabriz was a military action of the Ottoman–Safavid War (1623–1639). During this action the Ottoman Empire occupied and sacked the Safavid city of Tabriz. The city is located in the northwest of modern-day Iran." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q125784315, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1635 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
